about_the_game:
This Demo contains the first Act of the full game: first map "Ruined City", 7 unlockable artifacts, 7 story book chapters, first map Boss.

You awaken as a Doll in a desolate, crumbling city with no memories. The path to the Royal Palace lies ahead, but hostile automatons and arcane golems stand in your way. To reach your destination, you must face three powerful foes, each guarding a crucial place of your journey.

Before each run in Arcane Path, you’ll choose one of the 12 artifacts that shape your gameplay. Each artifact grants unique status effects, enhances starting cards with powerful bonuses, and adds thematic cards to your deck. Artifacts also influence battle rewards, ensuring key victories provide cards aligned with the artifact’s theme, which in turn offer new strategies and playstyles.
An ancient book whispers of forgotten powers tied to the 12 relics and the forces that set your quest in motion. Its cryptic pages reveal the marvels of a bygone era, hinting at a fateful ritual that left the city in ruins.
Claviger, the owl mask automaton, and her leader, Emerald Oracle, offer their aid on your path to the heart of the enchanted city.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: windows 10
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-8145U CPU @ 2.10GHz (4 CPUs)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 620 (Shared memory: 4027 MB)
  • Additional Notes: The listed specifications reflect the lowest-end system on which the game was successfully tested. It may still be playable on lower-end hardware.

short_description: Unlock 12 ancient artifacts, each bestowing special powers and a unique starting deck. Battle relentless automatons on your quest to the heart of the enchanted city as you uncover stories of an ancient book.
